items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What would you tell Ralph here about?

ctx.x: What would you tell him? What would you tell Ralph here about?

How you blow it, that's all. The right way to blow it. In other words, to learn his horn. Yes, that's the first one. What I would like to do with some of this material that you are recording, I would like to, if possible, get some of it published someday. If you had any advice to give about playing like in a jazz band, just what you do with a tune, so that young musicians that are coming up and will come up in future years would have an idea just what your advice would be.
